proposals.evidence: Turner4656 gives Prakrit cālīsa, regional cālis/cālīs, Gujarati cāḷīś and Marathi ċāḷīs. These support the survey lateral variants; source c is retained without assigning it a new phonetic value. Turner marks the Marathi cā- variant as Hindi-influenced, so this family link does not establish an entirely contact-free history; the survey notation does not resolve that distinction. Printed source and ingestion audit checked. Existing transcription and chapter-based Katkari mapping uncertainty retained.
